description: This file defines the MinidumpGenerator class for creating minidump crash reports on Windows, including methods for setting dump files, generating dump file names, and writing minidumps. It includes Windows API and Google Breakpad specific structures and functions.

classes.name: MinidumpGenerator
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the process of generating minidump crash reports on Windows, managing dump file creation, and interfacing with Windows debugging APIs.

methods.name: SetDumpFile
methods.description: Sets the handle for the dump file.

methods.name: SetFullDumpFile
methods.description: Sets the handle for the full dump file.

methods.name: GenerateDumpFile
methods.description: Generates a dump file name and path for the crash dump.

methods.name: GenerateFullDumpFile
methods.description: Generates a full dump file name and path, including full memory if specified.

methods.name: SetAdditionalStreams
methods.description: Sets additional data streams to include in the dump.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for dump process stages.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Writes the minidump to the specified dump file.
